{{Infobox auto}}

'''Pumpkin curry''' is an oven meal of the [[pumpkin]]. It heals {{Hp|20}} and grants {{EffectLink|Resistance}} for 20 minutes, the longest Resistance from food. It is the only oven meal that can't be cooked on [[kindling]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/pumpkin_curry.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[pumpkin curry stock]] cooks into pumpkin curry in 15 seconds in an [[oven]]. Obtaining the stock unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 3 seconds, heals {{Hp|20}} and gives Resistance I for 20:00. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].

== Advancements ==
* ''Fortified Goodness'': make pumpkin curry (1 [[obol]]).
